title: 第一章 吻完就跑？这男人我要定了
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
“冒犯了。”

    姜无念还没反应过来，手腕就被男人扣住，微凉的唇不由分说地覆下来。

    好香啊……这是什么？

    暖意顺着唇瓣涌入体内，孜孜不倦地修补着残破的神魂。

    她是修真界的人，渡劫失败被雷劈了个魂飞魄散。

    好消息是，她仅存的一缕残魂穿进这具刚死的身体，有了栖息之所。

    坏消息是，这个世界灵气稀薄，无法靠修炼凝实魂魄，她马上又要灰飞烟灭了。

    眼前男人不知什么来头，和他接触几秒，神魂竟迅速充盈起来，她一动都不敢动，藏在袖中的指尖极轻地蜷了一下。

    想要更多！

    这个念头一冒出来，灵力不受控制的躁动。下一秒，她反客为主，贪婪汲取。

    男人身体猛地一颤，神情明显乱了分寸，嘴里像是被什么东西烫到似的，推开她仓促后退半步。

    他下颌线紧绷，带着怒气盯着面前的人，“你怎么……”

    “伸舌头”三个字，他实在说不出口。

    “我？我怎么啦？”姜无念有些懵，也有些恼，正吸得带劲怎么就停了。

    要是多吸一会，说不定神魂就补好了。

    男人无奈的叹了口气，警惕地看了看四周，目光落到巷口，那里站着几个人，正是刚从巷子里经过的。

    待他们彻底走远，他拿出几张钞票放在姜无念怀里：“多谢。”

    他就这么跑了。

    看着男人离开的方向，姜无念人畜无害的神情一点点褪去，指尖轻触唇角，任由怀里的钱被风吹得四散。

    这人她要定了。

    指尖轻掐，神色有些凝重，“死劫。”

    今晚他必死。

    不过......

    想到刚才的神魂舒畅，他可不能就这么没了。

    城郊公路。

    护栏被撞开一道豁口，黑色跑车大半悬在空中，随时会坠下去，驾驶室里卡着一道身影。

    姜无念站在坡下，几步攀上路基，衣服被树枝划破也不在意，她伸出手指，轻轻一勾，几吨重的跑车被拉回路面。

    车身扭曲变形，车门碎裂，她捡了根树枝，戳了戳车里的人。

    男人双眸紧闭，脸色惨白，衣服被鲜血浸透，额前几缕碎发被冷汗浸湿，唇角有着未干涸的血痕，右臂被金属碎片死死钉在椅背上。
content_en:
"Offended."

    Before Jiang Wunian could react, his wrist was clasped by the man, and his slightly cold lips were pressed down involuntarily.

    It smells so good...what is this?

    Warmth poured into the body along the lips, tirelessly repairing the broken soul.

    She is from the world of cultivation. She failed to escape the tribulation and was struck by lightning.

    The good news is that her remaining remnant soul has penetrated into this newly deceased body and has a place to live.

    The bad news is that the spiritual energy in this world is thin and it is impossible to solidify the soul through practice. She will soon be wiped out again.

    The origin of the man in front of her was unknown. After being in contact with him for a few seconds, her soul quickly became filled with energy. She did not dare to move, and the fingertips hidden in her sleeves curled up slightly.

    Want more!

    As soon as this thought came up, his spiritual power became uncontrollable. The next second, she turned her back on the customer and greedily absorbed it.

    The man's body trembled suddenly, his expression was obviously confused, and his mouth seemed to be burned by something. He pushed her away and took half a step back hastily.

    His jawline was tense and he stared at the person in front of him angrily, "How did you..."

    He really couldn't say the words "stick out his tongue".

    "Me? What's wrong with me?" Jiang Wu Nian was a little confused and a little annoyed. He was sucking vigorously and then he stopped.

    If he breathed for a while longer, his soul might be healed.

    The man sighed helplessly, looked around warily, and his eyes fell on the entrance of the alley. There were several people standing there, who had just passed by the alley.

    After they were completely gone, he took out a few bills and put them in Jiang Wu Nian's arms: "Thank you."

    He just ran away.

    Looking at the direction in which the man was leaving, Jiang Wu Nian's harmless expression gradually faded away. He touched the corners of his lips lightly with his fingertips and let the money in his arms be blown away by the wind.

    She was determined to make a decision on this person.

    He pinched it lightly with his fingertips and said with a serious expression, "Death calamity."

    He must die tonight.

    But...

    Thinking of the soothing feeling just now, he couldn't just let it go.

    Suburban roads.

    A gap was opened in the guardrail. Most of the black sports car was hanging in the air and could fall at any time. A figure was stuck in the cab.

    Jiang Wunian stood at the bottom of the slope and climbed up the roadbed in a few steps. She didn't care if her clothes were torn by branches. She stretched out her finger and flicked it, and the several-ton sports car was pulled back to the road.

    The car body was twisted and deformed, and the door was shattered. She picked up a branch and poked the people in the car.

    The man's eyes were closed tightly, his face was pale, his clothes were soaked with blood, a few strands of hair on his forehead were soaked with cold sweat, there were still blood marks on the corners of his lips, and his right arm was nailed to the back of the chair by metal fragments.
title_en: Chapter 1 Run away after kissing? I want to settle on this man
